description: Finish signing in. Call it after datailo_connect with the request_id (and the six-digit code if the user reads it to you). Until the person has opened the confirmation link in their email, reviewed the linked terms, ticked the acknowledgement and confirmed, it answers at once that this human step is still needed; call it again with the same request_id when they say they have confirmed. The person must review the linked terms and tick the acknowledgement on their email confirmation page themselves. Never accept for them. A terms_acknowledgement_required state needs that human action; do not keep retrying. On success a durable dat_ key is issued (shown once) and, for clients without a connection session, a `session` value to pass on every later call; then carry on with what the user asked for.
name: datailo_connect_verify
title: Sign in (step 2 of 2)
